verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents its own alerting feature ('Fivetran Alerts'). Its official MCP server can report when a connection last completed a sync and whether connections are broken, which gives connection-level freshness. The evidence does not show per-table freshness in the destination or alerts that fire specifically when a sync misses its expected cadence. Missing for 10: per-destination-table freshness visibility, documented missed-cadence/delay alerting, alert content and configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I can tell how fresh each destination table is and get warned when a pipeline misses its expected cadence

citations.quote: It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?"
